description: This file defines a singleton class `NotifyOverlayController` which manages showing and dismissing custom toast-style notification overlays within a macOS application using AppKit and SwiftUI. It includes features for presenting notifications with titles and bodies, auto-dismissal, and animated presentation/dismissal.

classes.name: NotifyOverlayController
classes.description: A singleton controller class responsible for displaying and managing in-app toast notifications within a macOS app.

methods.name: present
methods.description: Displays a notification overlay with a given title and body, optionally auto-dismissed after a specified interval.

methods.name: dismiss
methods.description: Hides the currently displayed notification overlay.

methods.name: ensureWindow
methods.description: Ensures the notification panel window exists, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: presentWindow
methods.description: Handles presenting the notification window with animation and positioning.

methods.name: targetFrame
methods.description: Calculates the position and size of the notification overlay based on the screen dimensions.

methods.name: updateWindowFrame
methods.description: Updates the window's frame to the target frame, optionally with animation.

methods.name: measuredHeight
methods.description: Calculates the height of the notification overlay based on its content.
